newsitem.title: USA: Interdigital sees Q3 revs lower than Q1, Q2.
newsitem.headline: Interdigital sees Q3 revs lower than Q1, Q2.

text.p: InterDigital Communications Corp said Friday it expects lower revenues in the second half of the year than it had in the first half.
It also expects lower revenues in the third quarter than it had in the first and second quarters, with sales accelerating in the fourth quarter as production begins on its Burma contract.
The company also said sales momentum should grow further in 1998 as it moves into a steady rate of production for Burma and as it produce systems for other customers.
The company reported a second quarter loss per share of $0.17 compared with a profit per share of $0.01 for the same period a year ago. Revenues were $18.2 million compared with $14.1 million.
